title: Shinonome Ena — What Wounds Can't Break〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Ena's Room

rows.Speaker: Ena's Voice
rows.Line: I'm back.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Kanade and Mafuyu are already logged in...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What about Mizuki...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I had a feeling...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (None of my messages have been marked as read. There isn't even any evidence of having logged on to Nightcord...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I sorta wish we used more than just one messaging platform.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No, it's easy enough to just block someone...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey, did you hear about Forte la Zeal's next product?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, that's the really cute cosmetics brand people were talking about. They have some new stuff?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, it's colored pearl powder!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You've gotta see this! This is just a sample image, but it's super cute! Doesn't it look like there are bits of candy mixed in?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, that is really cute! And would be great for social media!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I know, right?!
It doesn't release for a little while, but we should go get it together when it does!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: This shop sells really cute clothes at reasonable prices. Maybe I'll grab some stuff here next season too.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Nice!
I'm totally gonna put together such an amazing outfit for you!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hmm... The outfits you come up with do look nice, but they're always a little too cutesy for me to wear.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
That's not true!
My choices are based on colors and designs that I think would look really good on you!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Really...? Then, maybe I should give your outfits more of a chance.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wait, does that mean you never actually intended to wear them?! After I put so much thought into them?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Again, they look way too cutesy for me...
But I'm sorry, alright!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Too bad that cafe was undergoing renovations...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I was really looking forward to having some of their giant pudding. It looked so good. They could've at least posted an announcement on their website...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: They made a post on social media, so it's sorta our fault for not checking.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Still, closed for two months.
That's about when the school festival's supposed to end, right...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: On the other hand, we get to look forward to having delicious pudding at a freshly renovated cafe.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: True...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Then, let's go when they open back up!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Forte la Zeal's releasing their new product soon.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And that cafe had their grand reopening...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: All these new clothes and cosmetics are coming out.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: The others in class have been talking about winter exams and what they're gonna do over the holidays...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It's like the world's moving on without us...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Am I really never going to see...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No, don't say stuff like that.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: If I have time to think about that, then I have time to figure out where Mizuki is.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: There's still some time left until I have to work on N25 stuff, so I should list down where Mizuki works and likes to hang out...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I have more free time than usual this week since I wasn't assigned anything for art class, but that probably means we'll be given an assignment next week... Which means this is my only chance to keep looking.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Mizuki...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Can't we just talk for a little bit...?)
